sample: Every galaxy of the prepared Local Group catalogue (LVDB v1.1.1, its 776 eligible rows) nearer than the Cosmicflows-4 field's nearest galaxy (3.03 Mpc), except those drawn as their own objects: 200 galaxies with the catalogue's adopted distance and LVDB's apparent V magnitude (packages/bake/authoring/nearby-universe/local-group-sample.mts).
meaning: The galaxies of the Local Volume Database inside the Cosmicflows-4 field's inner edge, so the field's dots continue into the Local Group.

toneBy.basis: Presentation of a measured quantity: the field's tone law, full at -21.5 and 30% at -17.5, on each galaxy's absolute V magnitude (LVDB has no B); nearly all these galaxies are dwarfs fainter than -17.5 and take the faintest tone, as do the 7 without a V magnitude. LVDB gives no morphological type, so each is the field's untyped white.
